reader_notes: Arithmetic and hedging are internally consistent: 96 inventoried, 32 still correct, 27 of those at ferry berths / bus stations / schoolyards / factory gates, and the expensive clocks only 'gick oftare fel' — which is exactly what makes the absolutist option B ('alltid rätt' / 'varje ur ... hade stannat') wrong rather than merely weaker.

'Av de trettiotvå ur som fortfarande visade rätt tid' uses the indefinite plural after de + numeral; this is correct Swedish before a restrictive relative clause and read naturally to me, noting it only because it can look like a missing definite ending at a glance.
